title: Find the largest number
statement: Write a function `largestNumber(numbers)` that returns the biggest number in the array. If the array is empty, return `null`. Do not use `Math.max`; practise doing it with a loop.
fallbackHints: If someone handed you a list of numbers one at a time, what single number would you keep in your head?
You need to remember the best number seen so far and compare each new one against it. Also think about what the answer should be when there is nothing to look at.
Starting the 'best so far' at 0 breaks when every number is negative. Which value from the array itself would be a safer starting point? Handle the empty array before you look at any item.
